resources.string: Talk to the Gemini-powered agent. It edits your code, commits, pushes and runs builds on GitHub Actions.
List, search, create, clone and fork your GitHub repositories.
Browse files, edit code, and manage changes, branches and history.
Start builds on GitHub Actions, follow them live, read logs and install the APK.
Create, review, comment on and merge pull requests.
List, read, create and comment on issues.
Create tags and releases, and attach APKs.
Resume, rename and delete past agent sessions.
Gemini key and model, GitHub account, permission mode, theme and language.
GCode is an agentic coding assistant for Android. The AI backend is the Google Gemini API with your own key. All builds run on GitHub Actions; nothing is compiled on this device.
